    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AssetManager
    Manages the loading and caching of game assets.
    ChessAI
    A chess-playing opponent.
    ChessAIFactory
    Creates ChessAI instances for a given Opponent, and reports which opponents are currently available to select.
    ChessPiece
    ChessPiece class represents a chess piece.
    ChessPiece.PieceType
    Enum representing the type of the chess piece.
    ContextRenderingHandler
    Class handling the rendering of the context.
    GameController
    The game controller.
    GameRendererComponent
    GameRendererComponent class extends JPanel and handles the game render.
    GameRendererComponent.GameConfig
    Gets the game configuration.
    GameRendererComponent.GameMode
    Gets the game mode.

    GameState class represents the state of the chess game.
    GameState.BoardSquareConsumer
    Functional interface for board iteration callbacks.
    GameState.GameStatus
    Enum representing the status of the game.
    GameState.MoveResult
    Enum representing the result of a move.
    GraphicsUtils
    GraphicsUtils class provides utility methods for graphics operations.
    Main
    Main class for the chess application.
    Matrix4
    Represents a 4x4 matrix.
    MinimaxAI
    Implements a minimax-based AI opponent for chess.
    Move
    Represents a chess move.
    MoveManager
    Manages move validation strategies for different piece types.
    MoveManager.MoveValidationStrategy
    Interface for move validation strategies.
    Opponent
    Identifies which opponent the human is playing against.
    ProjectionRenderingHandler
    Handles the projection rendering.
    SidePreference
    The side preference.

    Manages sound playback for the game.
    TimerMode
    The timer mode.
    UciEngineAI
    A ChessAI backed by an external UCI engine.
    Vector3
    A 3D vector.
    Window
    The main window of the application.
